Organisation
element.documentation: A department, arm's length body or other organisation that holds, provides or uses data.

element.name: RoleAssignment
element.documentation: Who holds an accountability for an asset. Names are held only in the organisation's own records.

element.name: DataAsset
element.documentation: A critical data asset, or any data set managed by the capability.

element.name: Distribution
element.documentation: A file, API or other way the asset is made available.

element.name: DataSharingAgreement
element.documentation: An agreement under which an asset is provided to or acquired from another organisation.

element.name: MetadataRecord
element.documentation: A catalogue record describing the asset in a metadata standard, with its gap assessment.

element.name: DataItem
element.documentation: A critical data item (field, table or element) within an asset.

element.name: UserNeed
element.documentation: A user group of the asset and what quality it needs.

element.name: DataQualityActionPlan
element.documentation: The DQAP, or equivalent mechanism, for one asset; covers the 7 steps.

element.name: QualityRule
element.documentation: A data quality rule with its dimension, method and agreed target.

element.name: MeasurementRun
element.documentation: One assessment of an asset against its rules.

element.name: RuleResult
element.documentation: The result of one rule in one run.

element.name: Issue
element.documentation: A rule that misses its target, logged in the Data Issues Log.

element.name: RootCause
element.documentation: The cause of an issue, found by root cause analysis.

element.name: RemediationAction
element.documentation: An action to contain, correct or prevent an issue.

element.name: Escalation
element.documentation: An issue escalated because it is overdue.

element.name: CommunicationPlanEntry
element.documentation: Who needs to know what about the asset's quality, how and how often.

element.name: QualityStatement
element.documentation: A plain English statement of an asset's quality, strengths and limitations.

element.name: AssetReturn
element.documentation: One asset's row in the return to GDS.

element.name: AnnualReview
element.documentation: The yearly review of an asset, its owner, metadata and DQAP.

element.name: Requirement
element.documentation: A requirement from policy, guidance or a standard (the requirements register).

element.name: MaturityAssessment
element.documentation: An organisation's self-assessed data quality maturity, by theme.

element.name: Identify and register critical data assets
Lead the exercise and nominate a coordinator
List data provided to or acquired from other organisations
Designate the asset and name the data owner
Check the metadata against the UK profile
Register in the catalogue and report to GDS
Data quality action plan lifecycle (7 steps)
1. Identify critical data and known issues
2. Identify users, needs and quality rules
5. Find root causes and take action
Use the data with its caveats; report problems
Log the issue in the Data Issues Log
Score: importance x impact x band
Set priority and target resolution date
Caveat, communicate and raise with the supplier
Agree containment, corrective and preventive actions
Run every rule and keep the history
Publish results, DQV metadata and the return
Confirm the asset is still critical
Name a successor and update the metadata
Review the metadata against the 13 properties
Check the DQAP covers all 7 steps
Assure returns across the department and its ALBs
